reviews.title: Major Limitation of the Notes Feature
reviews.text:
At present, Notes appears to be just one continuous note. Anything entered is added to the same page, so over time it could become hundreds or even thousands of lines long.

There is no option to:

• Create separate notes with different titles
• Organize notes into folders or subfolders
• Attach individual notes to specific dates, such as July 22, July 23, or July 24
• Search notes by title or tag
• Easily find and manage older notes.

It does not make sense for users to keep writing in one single note for several years. This makes the Notes feature difficult to organize and impractical for long-term use.

Please consider allowing users to create multiple notes, name them, organize them into folders, and link them to specific dates. The current design is a major limitation of the Notes feature.

reviews.title: Treating Existing Customers like Dirt
reviews.text:
I bought the ‘pro’ version of this app a number of years ago. I’ve been using it daily and recommending it to friends.

What do you get for being a loyal and early supporter? Spam messages on your app prompting you to pay more. Features hidden behind a new paywall. The loss of trust that next year we won’t be ripped off for even more money from this company.

I’m so disappointed. If you treat your customer with respect, they will stay for life. If the update was something reasonable, like £2-3, I could understand. Yet to ask for £11.99 from a loyal existing customer is not right in this cost of living climate.

I have been happy to pay for an update with other apps, such as the Moment camera Pro 2, as it would vastly improve from its previous version, and it was only £3 to update. That’s something to learn from. If you’re reasonable with your customers, they’ll be reasonable with you.

As such, I will not be paying for any future update, and I will be finding a different app that treats its customers with greater respect.

reviews.title: Gute App, enttäuschendes Preismodell
reviews.text:
Ich nutze die App seit Jahren wirklich gerne und war immer super zufrieden. Umso enttäuschter bin ich jetzt darüber, dass man plötzlich so stark zur Kasse gebeten wird, wenn man die App weiterhin vernünftig nutzen möchte. 

Grundsätzlich habe ich Verständnis dafür, dass gute Apps Geld kosten dürfen. Aber 25 € finde ich für eine Wochenplan-App einfach viel zu teuer, vor allem als Abo bzw. für Funktionen, die vorher selbstverständlich waren. Für einen einmaligen Preis von 5–10 € für lebenslange Nutzung hätte ich absolut Verständnis gehabt und das auch gerne bezahlt. 

So fühlt es sich leider eher unfair gegenüber langjährigen Nutzern an, die die App über Jahre unterstützt und genutzt haben. Wirklich schade, denn die App selbst war bisher top und ich habe sie immer gerne weiterempfohlen.

reviews.title: Was my favourite planner for years - now incredibly disappointed
reviews.text: I have been using this planner app since 2021 and it has been a perfect, simple planner that has everything I have needed. However, they have just released a new update that has completely changed this. I had paid for the premium version previously, but now that has been made redundant and I have been reverted back to the free version as they've implemented a new subscription service in its place. The free version is now completely unusuable as a calendar and planner in the way that I have been using it. You can only edit the week you are currently in, and all future weeks are now "read-only", meaning you can't edit them, so you can't add future events into your calendar until you are in that week. Moreover, the panel at the bottom of the screen telling you that it is read-only and telling you to upgrade to premium covers Sunday, so you can't even see all of the week anyway! Why is it that I can now play a random unrelated game in my diary app in the free version, but not actually update my calendar! I am incredibly disappointed in this, as I said at the start of the review I have been using this app for years with no problems and it is a great shame that I now feel I will have to look elsewhere for a new app, or be forced to pay much more than I already had paid just to be able to use my planner app as a suitable planner.
